name: Tama
source:
Tama is a strange creature that lives with [url=/c97713]Frostvine[/url], apparently an odd class of monster. She's a catgirl, a sentient being that shares many similarities with humans but also with cats. The most notorious traits she has is her heterochromia iridum, meaning her eyes are different colors, and two longer canines. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Tama]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
